sharedRules.name: Gravity Manipulator
sharedRules.description:
Friendly Ships in Orbit that start their movement within this station's Scan range increase their Group's total movement (after Orders) by 2". If all Ships in that Group are within this station's Scan range, that Group instead increases its total movement (after Orders) by 4" and gains Vectored until the end of its activation. Groups can only be affected by this rule once in their activation and only while that Group is in Coherency.
This special rule ceases to function while you do not control this station.

sharedRules.name: Hypersummoning
sharedRules.description: If you control this Space Station, when you launch a Wing from a friendly Bioficer Ship, instead of launching them normally, you may place them anywhere within 18" of this Space Station. Wings placed this way suffer the effects of any scenery they are placed on but ignore intervening scenery. Wings placed this way count as having moved but may form and divide into Wings as if they had moved normally but cannot move or form and divide into Wings during the Asset Phase. Wings placed this way cannot be the target of your Abilities until the end of the round (other players may target them with Abilities as normal).

sharedRules.name: Signature Bloom
sharedRules.description:
Friendly Ships within this Space Station's unmodified Signature are Hidden within its Bloom. Enemy Ships targeting a Hidden Ship's Group ignore two Spike if all Ships in the Group are Hidden.
This rule has no effect while this Space Station is controlled by an enemy player.

sharedRules.name: Signature Bloom (AO)
sharedRules.description:
Friendly Ships within 6" of this Space Station are Hidden within its Bloom. Enemy Ships targeting a Hidden Ship's Group ignore a Spike for each Hidden Ship in that Group.
This rule has no effect while this Space Station is controlled by an enemy player.

sharedRules.name: Slow Traversal
sharedRules.description: This Space Station uses arcs as if it was a Ship and may only be turned due to this rule. When this Space Station is activated, you may turn it up to 22 degrees in any direction (22 degrees is the size of the FN Arc), even if it is controlled or contested by an opponent.

sharedRules.name: Summoned Ingress
sharedRules.description: From the 2nd round onwards while you control this Space Station, when a Group of L Tonnage not on the table deploys, you may treat this Space Stations front Arc up to 6" away as that Group's deployment zone. If a Group deploys this way, roll a dice for each Ship in that Group and apply the corresponding Crippling Effect to the Ship and the Group cannot attack or launch Assets this round.

sharedRules.name: Voidspace Anchor
sharedRules.description: When an enemy Group within 6" of this Space Station activates, that Group may only move up to half of its Thrust this activation regardless of selected Order.

rules.name: Dimensional Hypershredder
rules.description: When you attack with this weapon, choose Energy or Kinetic. This weapon's Type becomes the chosen Type for this attack.

rules.name: Heavy Vent Cannon Turret
rules.description: When you assign targets to this weapon, you may have this Space Station gain 2 Spikes, if you do, it counts as going on Weapons Free Orders for the purposes of its Special rules.

rules.name: Station Disintegrator Bank
rules.description:
Instead of the normal Arcs, Shaltari Shurikens have their own Arcs. A Shuriken has 5 Arcs, each 72 degrees. The easiest way to define these Arcs is to follow the lines of adjacent vertical vanes, measured from the flight stand as normal. Follow these arcs when attacking instead of the normal rules for Arcs.
When you assign targets to this weapon, you may only use each Arc once.

rules.name: Station Turret Rack
rules.description: When you attack with this weapon, roll once and apply the roll to all enemy Groups within range.

rules.name: Station Turret Ring
rules.description: When you attack with this weapon, roll once and apply the roll to all enemy Groups within range.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When this Space Station targets enemy ships, Spikes on those ships have double their normal effect. So a Spike would increase the target's Signature by 6" instead of 3".

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This Space Station's Scan range is increased by 3". In addition, friendly ships within 3" of one or more Space Stations with this special rule increase their Scan range by 3". This special rule ceases to function while this Space Station is controlled by an enemy player.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
Defensive Garrison (Defender): This Structure does not cost points and can only be taken by a player that is the Defender in a scenario, choosing the scenario and agreeing with your opponent ahead of time. This Space Station starts the game with 2/3/4 Battalions on it for Small/Medium/Large Space Stations respectively. A Space Station that takes a Defensive Garrison cannot take any other Structures.
Forward Operating Base (Attacker): This Feature does not cost points and can only be taken by a player that is the Attacker in a scenario, choosing the scenario and agreeing with your opponent ahead of time. This Space Station may launch a single Bomber each round in addition to its normal launch (following Launch timing, restrictions, and your faction's Bombers rules). Instead of attacking normally, you may remove this Bomber to place 2 Battalions on a Ship or Space Station in base contact with it. A Space Station that takes a Forward Operating Base cannot take any other Structures.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This feature uses its Space Station's best available saves. When all Launch Control Features are removed from a Space Station, that Station cannot Launch Assets

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This feature uses its Space Station's best available saves. When all Weapons Control Features are removed from a Space Station, that Station cannot use its Weapon Systems

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When this Feature is removed, each player removes a Battalion from this Space Station. If this Space Station started with at least one Life Support Feature and has none remaining, at the end of each Cleanup step, each player removes a Battalion from this Space Station.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When this Feature or a Space Station with this feature is destroyed, it explodes with a Reactor Overload Explosion Effect with a range of D6+3".

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This Space Station gains a 6+ Backup Save.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This Space Station's Close Action weapons gain 6" additional range.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: During the Activation and Asset Phases, you count as controlling this Space Station
